description: Implementation of the GeneratorImpl class in PyTorch, including methods for cloning, device retrieval, and random number generation, with platform-specific code for SGX, Windows, and Unix-like systems.

classes.name: GeneratorImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a generator object managing device and state, with cloning and platform-specific random number generation.

methods.name: GeneratorImpl::clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the generator object.

methods.name: GeneratorImpl::graphsafe_set_state
methods.description: Stub method indicating setting state is not supported.

methods.name: GeneratorImpl::graphsafe_get_state
methods.description: Stub method indicating getting state is not supported.

methods.name: GeneratorImpl::device
methods.description: Returns the device associated with the generator.

methods.name: detail::readURandomLong
methods.description: Reads a 64-bit random number from /dev/urandom on Unix-like systems.

methods.name: detail::getNonDeterministicRandom
methods.description: Generates a non-deterministic random number, platform-specific, using /dev/urandom, sgx_read_rand, or std::random_device.
